methodology.identity_scope: Every partial ability/item and unsupported move in the generated reachable-mechanics manifest.
methodology.move_dependencies: Derived from resolved move execution requirements; only capabilities not currently implemented or verified are blockers.
methodology.ability_item_dependencies: Reviewed capability groups validated against the complete generated target set.
methodology.unlocked_rule: An identity is unlocked only when every dependency is implemented or verified; current partial/unsupported identities therefore remain locked.

capabilities.title: Exceptional ability damage modifiers
known_gaps: Several modifier identities are registered but not interaction-complete.

capabilities.title: Ability mutation lifecycle
known_gaps: Copying, replacement, suppression, and activation ordering are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Ability replacement and activation transition
known_gaps: Ability changes are not represented by a shared lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Accuracy and evasion resolution
known_gaps: Exceptional always-hit and move-specific rules remain separate dependencies.

capabilities.title: Exceptional accuracy overrides
known_gaps: No Guard and move-specific accuracy overrides are not interaction-complete.

capabilities.title: Dynamic action-order modifiers
known_gaps: Quick Claw-style bracket modification is not integrated with the canonical queue.

capabilities.title: Non-selected and multi-target target resolution
known_gaps: Several move-specific target rewrites remain separate.

capabilities.title: Individual berry effect coverage
known_gaps: Confusion-curing and pinch-stat berries remain incomplete, so berry-dependent abilities are not interaction-complete for every reachable berry.

capabilities.title: Shared berry activation and consumption
known_gaps: The shared lifecycle is implemented; individual berry effects and Substitute damage routing remain separate capabilities.

capabilities.title: Move calling and copying
known_gaps: Copycat, Sleep Talk, and other callers are not executable.

capabilities.title: Choice-item move locking
known_gaps: Choice Scarf modifies Speed but does not enforce a complete choice lock.

capabilities.title: Declarative conditional base power
known_gaps: Other variable-power predicates remain separate.

capabilities.title: Confusion lifecycle
known_gaps: Confusion is not end-to-end.

capabilities.title: Contact-triggered effects
known_gaps: Several abilities and items depend on unimplemented volatile/status/faint consequences.

capabilities.title: Move-specific callback orchestration
known_gaps: Resolved Showdown callbacks are recognized but not generically executable.

capabilities.title: Exceptional damage event lifecycle
known_gaps: Sturdy, Innards Out, Magic Guard, Liquid Ooze, and related effects need canonical event history.

capabilities.title: Declarative drain
known_gaps: Liquid Ooze and exceptional drain rules remain separate.

capabilities.title: Effective offensive/defensive stat override
known_gaps: Move-specific ignore rules remain separate.

capabilities.title: End-turn and delayed effects
known_gaps: Speed Boost, Cud Chew, Wish, Perish Song, and similar effects are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Ability-driven weather and terrain activation
known_gaps: Several setters exist, but entry and damage-triggered activation is not uniformly sequenced.

capabilities.title: Field, side, and slot condition lifecycle
known_gaps: Hazards, delayed effects, screens with special removal, and several side conditions are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Fixed and level-based damage
known_gaps: Interaction coverage is not differential-complete.

capabilities.title: Flinch lifecycle
known_gaps: Flinch is not represented by the canonical volatile lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Forced-switch lifecycle
known_gaps: Eject Button, Red Card, Emergency Exit, pivots, and phazing are not end-to-end.

capabilities.title: Battle form transformation
known_gaps: Mega and other battle transformations are not kernel-mediated end-to-end.

capabilities.title: Entry-hazard lifecycle
known_gaps: Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, Stealth Rock, and reactive hazard setters are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Ordinary direct healing
known_gaps: Weather-dependent and delayed healing remain separate.

capabilities.title: Ability-based immunity override
known_gaps: Exceptional immunity and suppression interactions remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Exceptional item effect modifiers
known_gaps: Identity metadata or one modifier does not cover the complete held-item behavior.

capabilities.title: Held-item mutation lifecycle
known_gaps: Theft, exchange, restoration, suppression, and consumed-item history are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Major-status application
known_gaps: Status cure, reflection, and move-specific status rules remain separate.

capabilities.title: Mega Evolution eligibility
known_gaps: Mega Stones are metadata-only.

capabilities.title: Mega Evolution action timing
known_gaps: No canonical Mega action lifecycle exists.

capabilities.title: Canonical move and action history
known_gaps: Several predicates and consecutive-use effects lack one authoritative history lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Status-move reflection
known_gaps: Magic Bounce is incomplete.

capabilities.title: Move type and power conversion abilities
known_gaps: Aerilate-family and Champions conversion abilities are not interaction-complete.

capabilities.title: Declarative multi-hit damage
known_gaps: Population Bomb-style accuracy and move-specific per-hit behavior remain separate.

capabilities.title: Ordinary non-damaging primary effects
known_gaps: Only declarative operations are implemented; special callbacks remain separate.

capabilities.title: Per-target hit resolution
known_gaps: Exceptional per-target callbacks remain separate.

capabilities.title: Pinch-berry activation thresholds
known_gaps: Stat-boosting pinch Berries and Gluttony threshold changes are not executable.

capabilities.title: PP restoration lifecycle
known_gaps: Leppa Berry and move-driven PP restoration are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Protect interception
known_gaps: Protect-family variants and contact retaliation remain separate.

capabilities.title: Declarative recoil
known_gaps: Crash damage and exceptional recoil rules remain separate.

capabilities.title: Follow Me and Rage Powder redirection
known_gaps: Ability redirection and exceptional bypass rules remain separate.

capabilities.title: Ability-based redirection
known_gaps: Lightning Rod-style redirection is incomplete.

capabilities.title: Partial-trapping lifecycle
known_gaps: Binding moves and Binding Band are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Fainted-target retargeting
known_gaps: Implemented and unit tested, but no isolated pinned differential fixture is recorded.

capabilities.title: Declarative chance secondaries
known_gaps: Volatile and custom secondaries depend on their own capabilities.

capabilities.title: Selected single-target resolution
known_gaps: No known gap for ordinary selected targets.

capabilities.title: Declarative self effects
known_gaps: Custom self effects remain separate.

capabilities.title: Exceptional move behavior
known_gaps: The move requires semantics outside the currently supported declarative executor.

capabilities.title: Spread-damage modifier
known_gaps: No known generic gap.

capabilities.title: Canonical damage calculation and application
known_gaps: No known gap in the ordinary damage path.

capabilities.title: Reactive stat-stage event lifecycle
known_gaps: Intimidate and other reactive boosts/drops are not complete across interactions.

capabilities.title: Stat restoration and inversion lifecycle
known_gaps: White Herb and several stage-manipulation moves are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Stat-stage application
known_gaps: Reflection, prevention, restoration, and event timing remain separate.

capabilities.title: Status cure lifecycle
known_gaps: Status berries, Heal Bell, Shed Skin, and related interactions are not unified.

capabilities.title: Reactive status lifecycle
known_gaps: Synchronize, Leaf Guard, Purifying Salt, and related interactions are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Substitute-sensitive damage routing
known_gaps: Resistance Berries cannot be promoted until damage and item activation distinguish Substitute damage from direct HP damage.

capabilities.title: Mid-turn switch control
known_gaps: Pivoting, phazing, item-driven switches, and ability-driven switches do not share an end-to-end lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Switch restriction and bypass
known_gaps: Shadow Tag, trapping volatiles, and Shed Shell are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Target-set construction
known_gaps: Move-specific exclusions remain separate.

capabilities.title: Shared volatile lifecycle
known_gaps: Only selected volatiles are executable; confusion, flinch, Taunt, Encore, Disable, Substitute, trapping, recharge, and invulnerability are incomplete.

capabilities.title: Volatile prevention and cure
known_gaps: Mental Herb-related volatiles do not use one canonical lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Weather suppression
known_gaps: Cloud Nine suppression is incomplete.
